alter table public.editors enable row level security;
alter table public.pages enable row level security;
alter table public.page_revisions enable row level security;

create or replace function public.is_editor()
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.editors e
    where e.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.is_editor_or_authenticated()
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.editors e
    where e.user_id = auth.uid()
  ) or auth.uid() is not null;
$$;

create policy "Anyone can read pages"
on public.pages
for select
to anon, authenticated
using (true);

create policy "Anyone can read pages by editors"
on public.editors
for select
to anon, authenticated
using (true);

create policy "Anyone can read revisions"
on public.page_revisions
for select
to anon, authenticated
using (true);

create policy "Authenticated readers can read authors of revisions"
on public.page_revisions
for select
to authenticated
using (true);

create policy "Authenticated users can create unprotected pages"
on public.pages
for insert
to authenticated
with check (
  is_protected = false
  and updated_by = auth.uid()
);

create policy "Editors can create protected pages"
on public.pages
for insert
to authenticated
with check (
  is_protected = true
  and public.is_editor()
);

create policy "Editors can edit unprotected pages"
on public.pages
for update
to authenticated
using (
  is_protected = false
  and updated_by = auth.uid()
)
with check (
  is_protected = false
  and updated_by = auth.uid()
);

create policy "Editors can edit protected pages"
on public.pages
for update
to authenticated
using (
  is_protected = true
  and public.is_editor()
)
with check (
  is_protected = true
  and public.is_editor()
);

create policy "Users can add revisions for editable pages"
on public.page_revisions
for insert
to authenticated
with check (
  public.is_editor_or_authenticated()
  and exists (
    select 1
    from public.pages p
    where p.slug = slug
      and (
        (is_protected = false and updated_by = auth.uid())
        or (is_protected = true and public.is_editor())
      )
  )
);

create or replace function public.pages_updated_by_editor()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if new.is_protected is distinct from old.is_protected
     or new.updated_by is distinct from old.updated_by then
    if not public.is_editor() then
      raise exception 'only editors can change is_protected or updated_by';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger pages_updated_by_editor
before update on public.pages
for each row
execute function public.pages_updated_by_editor();

```sql
alter table public.org_admins enable row level security;
alter table public.devices enable row level security;
alter table public.device_commands enable row level security;

create or replace function public.is_org_admin(p_org_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.org_admins
    where org_id = p_org_id and user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.device_org(p_device_id bigint)
returns bigint
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select d.org_id
  from public.devices d
  where d.id = p_device_id
  limit 1;
$$;

create or replace function public.device_assigned_to_me(p_device_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.devices d
    where d.id = p_device_id
      and d.assigned_to = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.can_issue_command(p_device_id bigint, p_command text)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select
    (
      case p_command
        when 'wipe' then public.is_org_admin(public.device_org(p_device_id))
        else public.device_assigned_to_me(p_device_id)
      end
    )
    and public.is_org_admin(public.device_org(p_device_id));
$$;

create or replace function public.device_commands_check()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if new.id is distinct from old.id
     or new.device_id is distinct from old.device_id
     or new.command is distinct from old.command
     or new.issued_by is distinct from old.issued_by
     or new.issued_at is distinct from old.issued_at then
    raise exception 'device_commands are immutable';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger device_commands_immutable
before update on public.device_commands
for each row execute function public.device_commands_check();

create policy org_admins_select on public.org_admins
  for select to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid() or public.is_org_admin(org_id));

create policy devices_select on public.devices
  for select to authenticated
  using (assigned_to = auth.uid() or public.is_org_admin(org_id));

create policy device_commands_select on public.device_commands
  for select to authenticated
  using (public.is_org_admin(public.device_org(device_id)));

create policy device_commands_insert on public.device_commands
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (
    issued_by = auth.uid()
    and public.can_issue_command(device_id, command)
  );
```
